exams.name: Registered Nursing or Practical Nursing Licensing Examination
exams.notes: Applies to RN and LPN applicants
exams.quote: An applicant for a license to practice registered or practical nursing shall pass a registered nursing or practical nursing licensing examination as prescribed by the board

exams.name: Advanced Practice Registered Nursing Certification Examination
exams.quote: An applicant for a license to practice advanced practice registered nursing shall pass an advanced practice registered nursing certification examination as prescribed by the board

interval_years.quote: Licenses shall be renewed biennially on the dates set by the department with the approval of the respective board.

required.quote: A license to practice nursing may not be renewed unless the nurse has complied with continuing competence requirements established by the board by regulation.

value: pain management and opioid use and addiction (minimum 2 hours, for APRNs with DEA registration numbers)
topical_requirements.quote: The regulations must require that a licensee receive not less than two hours of education in pain management and opioid use and addiction in the two years preceding an application for renewal of a license unless the licensee has demonstrated to the satisfaction of the board that the licensee does not currently hold a valid federal Drug Enforcement Administration registration number.

available.quote: The board may issue a license by endorsement to practice as a registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nurse, whichever is appropriate, to an applicant who has worked as a nurse within the past five years if the applicant is licensed as a registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nurse under the laws of another state

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed in another state, meet AK qualifications under AS 08.68.170, and have worked as a nurse within the past five years; or if not worked within five years, must also meet continuing competency requirements or complete a board-approved course of study.
requirements.quote: The board may issue a license by endorsement to practice as a registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nurse, whichever is appropriate, to an applicant who has worked as a nurse within the past five years if the applicant is licensed as a registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nurse under the laws of another state if, in the opinion of the board, the applicant meets the qualifications required for licensing in the state and meets the requirements of AS 08.68.170.

is_mandatory.quote: practice or offer to practice nursing without a license, unless the person is practicing within the scope of a delegation properly made under AS 08.68.805 or is giving necessary aid to the ill, injured, or infirm in an emergency

title_protection.quote: use in connection with the person's name a designation that implies that the person is a licensed nurse unless the person is licensed

disciplinary_grounds.quote: has been convicted of a felony or other crime if the felony or other crime is substantially related to the qualifications, functions, or duties of the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.quote: habitually abuses alcoholic beverages, or illegally uses controlled substances

disciplinary_grounds.quote: practices or attempts to practice nursing while afflicted with physical or mental illness, deterioration, or disability that interferes with the individual's performance of nursing functions

disciplinary_grounds.description: Guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined by board regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is guilty of unprofessional conduct as defined by regulations adopted by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Wilfully or repeatedly violated provisions of the nursing chapter or regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has wilfully or repeatedly violated a provision of this chapter or regulations adopted under this chapter or AS 08.01

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribed or dispensed an opioid in excess of the maximum dosage authorized by statute

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procured, sold, prescribed, or dispensed drugs in violation of law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: has procured, sold, prescribed, or dispensed drugs in violation of a law, regardless of whether there has been a criminal action or harm to the patient

definition_quote.value: practice of registered nursing means the performance for compensation or personal profit of acts of professional service that requires substantial specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill based on the principles of biological, physiological, behavioral, and sociological sciences in assessing and responding to the health needs of individuals, families, or communities
definition_quote.quote: "practice of registered nursing" means the performance for compensation or personal profit of acts of professional service that requires substantial specialized knowledge, judgment, and skill based on the principles of biological, physiological, behavioral, and sociological sciences in assessing and responding to the health needs of individuals, families, or communities

value: assessment of problems, counseling, and teaching clients to maintain health or prevent illness and in care of ill, injured, or infirm
administration, supervision, delegation, and evaluation of nursing practice
execution of a medical regimen as prescribed by a person authorized to practice medicine
performance of acts of medical diagnosis and prescription of medical therapeutic or corrective measures under board regulations (RN)
acts of medical diagnosis and prescription and dispensing of medical, therapeutic, or corrective measures (APRN)
methods_authorized.quote: assessment of problems, counseling, and teaching ... administration, supervision, delegation, and evaluation of nursing practice ... teaching others the skills of nursing ... execution of a medical regimen as prescribed by a person authorized by the state to practice medicine

drug_authority.value: Advanced practice registered nurses may prescribe and dispense medical, therapeutic, or corrective measures under board regulations, subject to opioid prescribing limits and DEA registration requirements for controlled substances.
drug_authority.quote: "advanced practice registered nurse" means a registered nurse licensed to practice in the state who, because of specialized education and experience, is certified to perform acts of medical diagnosis and the prescription and dispensing of medical, therapeutic, or corrective measures under regulations adopted by the board

value: advanced practice registered nurse (APRN) — including certified registered nurse anesthetist (CRNA), certified clinical nurse specialist (CNS), certified nurse practitioner (CNP), certified nurse midwife (CNM)
license_tiers.quote: A person practicing or offering to practice registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nursing in the state shall submit evidence of qualification to practice and shall be licensed under this chapter.

aprn_role_categories.quote: requirements for an advanced practice registered nurse to practice as a certified registered nurse anesthetist, certified clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse practitioner, or certified nurse midwife

lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: A practical nurse shall work under the supervision of a licensed registered or advanced practice registered nurse, a licensed physician, a licensed physician assistant, or a licensed dentist.

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: An advanced practice registered nurse may not issue an initial prescription for an opioid exceeding a seven-day supply to an adult for outpatient use, or any opioid prescription exceeding seven days to a minor; exceptions exist for chronic pain, cancer, palliative care, or logistical/travel barriers.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse may not issue (1) an initial prescription for an opioid that exceeds a seven-day supply to an adult patient for outpatient use; (2) a prescription for an opioid that exceeds a seven-day supply to a minor

dea_registration_required.quote: require that a licensed advanced practice registered nurse who has a federal Drug Enforcement Administration registration number register with the controlled substance prescription database under AS 17.30.200(n)

controlled_substance_database_registrati.quote: require that a licensed advanced practice registered nurse who has a federal Drug Enforcement Administration registration number register with the controlled substance prescription database under AS 17.30.200(n)

nurse_aide_registry_maintained.quote: The board shall maintain a registry of certified nurse aides.

delegation_to_unlicensed_personnel_autho.quote: A registered, advanced practice registered, or practical nurse licensed under this chapter may delegate nursing duties to other persons, including unlicensed assistive personnel, under regulations adopted by the board.

employer_mandatory_reporting_required.quote: An employer of a nurse licensed under this chapter ... that discharges or suspends a nurse or nurse aide or conditions or restricts the practice of a nurse or nurse aide shall, within seven working days after the action, report to the board the name and address of the person and the reason for the action.

whistleblower_protection_for_delegation_.quote: An employer may not discharge, threaten, or otherwise discriminate against a nurse employed by the employer regarding the nurse's compensation, terms, conditions, location, or privileges of employment for the nurse's refusal to perform a task involving nursing care delegated to the nurse by the nurse's superior if (1) the nurse alleges that the task was improperly delegated

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: the department may contract with public agencies and private professional organizations to provide assistance and treatment to persons licensed by the board who abuse alcohol, other drugs, or other substances

rn_death_pronouncement_authorized.quote: A registered nurse licensed under this chapter may make a determination and pronouncement of death of a person

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: An APRN may render a diagnosis, provide treatment, or prescribe/dispense/administer a non-controlled prescription drug without a physical examination if follow-up care is available and records are sent to the primary care provider with patient consent. Controlled substances may also be prescribed under the same conditions. However, an APRN may not prescribe in response to an Internet questionnaire or email to a person without a prior provider-patient relationship.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: an advanced practice registered nurse may not prescribe, dispense, or administer a prescription drug in response to an Internet questionnaire or electronic mail message to a person with whom the advanced practice registered nurse does not have a prior provider-patient relationship

military_education_credit_required.quote: Notwithstanding another provision of law, the department or applicable board shall accept military education, training, and service for some or all of the qualifications otherwise required of an applicant for a license or certificate issued under this chapter
